units.source_text: 而此時，淚水也從她的眼睛裡簌簌落下。

en.t: At that moment, tears also began streaming from her eyes.

units.source_text: 就這樣，我一句話也沒說，走出了那家藥店，

en.t: And so, without saying a single word, I left that pharmacy,

units.source_text: 搖搖晃晃地回到公寓，讓良子給我衝了一杯鹽水，喝完後默然睡去。

en.t: I staggered back to the apartment, had Yoshiko make me a cup of salt water, drank it, and silently fell asleep.

units.source_text: 第二天，我謊稱自己感冒，躺了整整一天。

en.t: The next day, I lied and said I had a cold, and lay in bed for the entire day.

units.source_text: 晚上，我對自己咯血的祕密深感不安，便起身又去了那家藥店，

en.t: That night, deeply uneasy about the secret of my coughing blood, I got up and went to that pharmacy again,

units.source_text: 這次我面帶笑容，坦白說出了自己的身體狀況，向她諮詢。

en.t: This time, smiling, I frankly told her about my physical condition and asked her advice.

units.source_text: 我們就像一家人一樣親近。

en.t: We were as close as family.

units.source_text: 「也許是酒精中毒吧，我現在還想喝呢。」

en.t: "Perhaps I am addicted to alcohol; even now I still want to drink."
